app.name: Tracepad
home.title: Python from Zero
home.lead: Predict first, then run, then see the memory. Everything runs in your browser.
home.guest: You are using Tracepad as a guest. Your work stays on this device. Create an account to keep it safe and to join a class.
home.notConfigured: This copy of Tracepad is not connected to an account server yet. You can read lessons and run code as a guest.
lesson.notTranslated: The lesson text is in English for now. The interface is in Persian.
lesson.notFound: That lesson or chapter does not exist.
lesson.loadFailed: The lesson could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
code.pressRun: Press Run to see the output.
code.loadingEngine: Loading Python. The first run downloads about 3 MB and is kept for next time.
code.timeout: Stopped: the program ran longer than {s, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
code.inputLabel: Input for this program (one line per input() call)
code.inputHelp: This program asks for input. Type the lines it will read, one per line.
code.inputPrompt: The program is waiting for input
code.engineFailed: Python could not start in this browser: {reason}
code.usesEarlier: This example uses code from earlier in the lesson. That code runs first, silently.
auth.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots and underscores, 3 to 30 characters.
auth.under13: Learners under 13 get an account from their teacher or school. Ask your teacher for a username and password.
auth.minorNote: If you are under 18, a parent or your school must agree to your account. Tracepad keeps only the data it needs to teach you.
auth.noEmail: I have no email address (sign in with a username)
auth.magicSent: Check your email. We sent a link that signs you in.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.confirmEmail: Almost done. Open the email we sent and click the link to confirm your address, then sign in.
auth.errInvalid: That email or password is not right.
auth.errExists: That username or email already has an account. Sign in, or choose another.
auth.errUsernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another one.
auth.errWeak: Choose a password with at least 10 characters.
auth.errRate: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errOffline: You are offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
profile.title: Your account
profile.teacherHelp: Enter the invite code your school gave you.
profile.emailChangeSent: We sent a confirmation to the new address. Click the link there to finish.
profile.signedOutOthers: All other devices were signed out.
profile.mfaWhy: Recommended for teachers and admins. You will enter a 6-digit code from an authenticator app when you sign in.
profile.mfaScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
profile.mfaSecret: Or type this key into the app: {secret}
profile.mfaBad: That code did not work. Try the newest code.
profile.privacyHelp: You own your learning data. Download a copy, or delete your account and everything linked to it.
profile.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, progress and notes. Type DELETE to confirm.
profile.deleteRefused: This kind of account cannot be deleted here. Ask the platform owner.
settings.title: Reading and display settings
settings.help: These settings are saved on this device and follow you when you sign in.
settings.preview: Preview: the quick brown fox predicts the output, runs the code, and sees the memory.
sync.offline: Offline. Your work is kept on this device and will be sent later.
sync.guest: Guest. Saved on this device only.
pwa.offlineReady: Lessons you opened are ready to use offline.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: That page does not exist. Go back to the course.
